zones.name: Harding, Butte, Northern Meade Co Plains, Pennington Co Plains, Haakon, Northern Oglala Lakota, Sturgis/Piedmont Foothills, Southern Meade Co Plains, Southern Oglala Lakota, Southern Perkins
zones.description: The grassland fire danger index will reach the moderate category this afternoon. Marginal weather conditions or a lowering moisture content of grasses, and other dry organic material on the ground, indicate that there is some potential for a fire to spread. Any outdoor burning should be closely monitored.

zones.name: Northern Perkins, Ziebach, Northern Foothills, Rapid City, Southern Foothills, Custer Co Plains, Western Fall River, Northern Jackson, Bennett, Mellette, Todd, Tripp, Hermosa Foothills, Eastern Fall River, Southern Jackson
zones.description: The grassland fire danger index will reach the low category this afternoon. Favorable weather conditions or a high moisture content of grasses, and other dry organic material on the ground, indicate that the probability of a fast moving fire is low. Outdoor burning under these conditions can usually be performed with reasonable safety precautions, but should be monitored.
